record.context_brief: Uniformity in spectral or weight aspect
record.original_question: For a Hecke-Maass cusp form f of level 1 and fixed spectral parameter t_f, Good proved that the second moment in t has the form integral from 0 to T of |L(1/2 + it, f)|^2 dt = T P1(log T) + O_{t_f,epsilon}(T^(2/3 + epsilon)). Make the dependence on t_f in the error term explicit, determine whether the error can be made independent of t_f when T >= t_f^(3/2 + delta) for some delta > 0, and obtain the analogous statement for holomorphic Hecke eigenforms of weight k_f.

evidence.quote: Crucially, the dependence on tf in the error term is not made explicit. Can one make this dependence explicit? In particular, does this error term not depend on tf if, say, T >= tf^(3/2+delta) for some delta > 0? How about for holomorphic Hecke eigenforms of weight kf ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f$ be a Hecke eigenform on $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$, and let $L(s,f)=\sum_{n\ge 1}\lambda_f(n)n^{-s}$ ($\Re s>1$) be its associated $L$-function, extended meromorphically to $\mathbb{C}$ via the standard functional equation. Two cases are considered:

(a) $f$ is a Hecke–Maass cusp form with Laplace eigenvalue $\tfrac14+t_f^2$, $t_f>0$.

(b) $f$ is a holomorphic Hecke eigenform of even weight $k_f\ge 2$.

For case (a), it is known that there exists a degree-one polynomial $P_1$ (depending on $f$) such that, for every $\varepsilon>0$,
$$\int_0^T |L(\tfrac12+it,f)|^2\,dt \;=\; T\,P_1(\log T) \;+\; O_{t_f,\varepsilon}\!\left(T^{2/3+\varepsilon}\right).$$
The dependence of the implied constant on the spectral parameter $t_f$ is not specified.

Tasks:

(1) Determine an explicit polynomial dependence on $t_f$ in the error term, i.e., produce an asymptotic of the form
$$\int_0^T |L(\tfrac12+it,f)|^2\,dt = T\,P_1(\log T) + O_{\varepsilon}\!\left(t_f^{A}\,T^{2/3+\varepsilon}\right)$$
for some explicit exponent $A\ge 0$.

(2) Decide whether there exists $\delta>0$ such that, in the range $T\ge t_f^{3/2+\delta}$, the error term can be made independent of $t_f$, i.e.,
$$\int_0^T |L(\tfrac12+it,f)|^2\,dt = T\,P_1(\log T) + O_{\varepsilon}\!\left(T^{2/3+\varepsilon}\right)$$
uniformly in $t_f$ subject to that constraint.

(3) Establish the analogous asymptotic for the holomorphic case (b), with explicit dependence on the weight $k_f$, and identify a range of $T$ in terms of $k_f$ in which the error term becomes independent of $k_f$.
artifact.status_search_result: Web search reveals active progress on related second-moment problems for GL(2) and GL(3)×GL(2) L-functions with hybrid uniformity in t- and spectral-aspect, but no source establishes the explicit t_f-dependence in Good's second-moment asymptotic for an individual Hecke–Maass form, nor the analogous explicit-weight statement for holomorphic eigenforms in the requested ranges. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Cubic moment of Hecke–Maass cusp forms and moments of L-functions
status_evidence.snippet: Studies moments with spectral and t-aspect uniformity but does not give the requested explicit t_f-dependence in Good's bound.
status_evidence.claim: Related but does not resolve the explicit-uniformity question.

status_evidence.title: Moments and hybrid subconvexity for symmetric-square L-functions
status_evidence.snippet: Sharp second-moment bounds for symmetric-square L-functions with spectral parameters in short intervals.
status_evidence.claim: Adjacent results on hybrid moments; the specific question on uniform Good-type asymptotic remains unaddressed.
